about_the_game:
Texas Twist Poker 3: Bandit’s Run is a poker-infused tile-puzzler with the strategic depth of a roguelike deck-builder. Combine unique Jokers and powerful upgrades to create the 10 best poker hands in a 52-card deck. Shop wisely between rounds to build a formidable deck and craft a winning strategy.

This DEMO features a dozen delightful barnyard beasts—each with their own quirks and challenges—to teach you the ropes and introduce the core mechanics of the full game.

Game Features:

♠ Endless Possibilities: Every deal, twist, and Joker reshapes your run.

♦ Barnyard Tutorial: Face a dozen barnyard beasts with unique rules and mechanics.

♥ Loads of Choices: Use Jokers, Mods, Upgrades, and Trinkets to create dynamic and heart-pounding synergies to work your way through the barnyard.

  • 100+ Jokers, each with unique abilities.

  • A baker’s dozen of boosts for each Joker adding further abilities.

  • 100+ card variants to enhance your deck.

  • 10 Upgrade cards to level up specific poker hands.

  • 24 Trinkets to provide permanent buffs for your current run.

♣ Immersive Experience: Dive into Texas culture and history as you cross the barnyard. Enjoy the flavors, wildlife, and geography as you twist your way across Texas!
